name: Queen's Gambit
description: A beginner course for challenging Black's d-pawn with c4 and understanding common replies.

branches.title: Main Line: Offer c4
branches.description: Learn the default Queen's Gambit start.

moves.title: Start with d4
moves.explanation: Controls central squares and opens the c1 bishop. d4 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. After c4, develop behind the pawn pressure, castle, and use trades to open files for rooks when the center clarifies.

moves.title: Black mirrors
moves.explanation: Black places a pawn on the same central front. d5 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. After c4, develop behind the pawn pressure, castle, and use trades to open files for rooks when the center clarifies.

moves.title: Challenge d5
moves.explanation: c4 attacks Black's d5 pawn and asks Black how they will defend the center. c4 changes the central structure. After c4, develop behind the pawn pressure, castle, and use trades to open files for rooks when the center clarifies.

moves.title: Black accepts
moves.explanation: Black grabs the c-pawn. The beginner response is not panic. dxc4 shows how trades enter the opening. This is an equal trade. Equal trades are good when they improve your structure, open a file, or remove an active enemy piece. After a trade, ask which file opened and which piece should improve next.
